source_audit.publisher: NYC Department of Parks and Recreation via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license: NYC Open Data / NYC.gov terms; dataset metadata license field null
source_audit.coverage: Capital projects managed by NYC Parks with phase dates, funding band, park ID, coordinates, borough and last-updated date.
source_audit.event_utility: Strong for observed completion-month candidates where currentphase is completed and constructionactualcompletion is populated.
source_audit.limitations: Completion dates are month-level tracker values and may be updated after project closeout. Tracker coordinates are project/park points, not measured work footprints. Summary text often uses future-tense template language even for completed records.
source_audit.recommendation: Use for candidate events with trackerid, fmsid, constructionactualcompletion, parkid, lat/lon and explicit caveat that completion is a tracker status.

source_audit.source_name: Affordable Housing Production by Project and Affordable Housing Production by Building
source_audit.publisher: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license: NYC Open Data / NYC.gov terms; dataset metadata license field null
source_audit.coverage: HPD housing projects that began after January 1, 2014 and are counted toward Housing New York or Housing Our Neighbors, with project completion dates; building file supplies building-level address, BBL/BIN and coordinates.
source_audit.event_utility: Usable for observed affordable-housing production completions when project rows are joined to building rows by project_id.
source_audit.limitations: Completion is HPD housing-production completion, not necessarily first occupancy, ribbon cutting, final DOB certificate, or completion of every non-housing space. Multi-building projects need one candidate per representative building or a geometry collection in later ETL.
source_audit.recommendation: Use as documented/corroborated administrative completion candidates with both project_id and building_id retained.

source_audit.source_name: Capital Projects Dashboard - Citywide Budget and Schedule
source_audit.publisher: Mayor's Office of Operations via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license: NYC Open Data / NYC.gov terms; dataset metadata license field null
source_audit.coverage: City capital budget and schedule dashboard records with FMS ID, agency, phase, borough/community board and budget fields.
source_audit.event_utility: Useful source-audit context for DDC/DCAS/NYPD/library capital work, but weaker for event candidates without separate project coordinates and actual completion dates.
source_audit.limitations: Rows often lack precise coordinates and may repeat across reporting periods. Current phase can show completed without an actual completion date in the queried row.
source_audit.recommendation: Do not ingest as standalone event candidates unless joined to project-point geometry and schedule-detail rows.

source_audit.source_name: Mayor Adams Opens 24 new School Buildings Ahead of 2024-2025 School Year
source_audit.publisher: NYC Mayor's Office / NYC Public Schools / NYC School Construction Authority
source_audit.coverage: Official announcement of 24 school buildings completed/opening for the 2024-2025 school year, with limited individual building detail on the page.
source_audit.event_utility: Good evidence for aggregate school opening and named P.S. 487 mention; individual school candidates need a second official SCA/DOE table for building code, address and designed seats.
source_audit.limitations: The press page is an announcement, not a row-level capital project dataset. It does not list every building, coordinates, cost, contractor or final certificate details.
source_audit.recommendation: Hold most SCA candidates until an official row-level SCA capital-plan table/PDF extraction is joined to DOE building coordinates.
